summary:
I built an interactive and immersive browser based web application and digital storybook designed to educate children about historical space exploration and real hardware left behind in space. It includes a character showcase featuring four space explorers Leo, Nova, Orion and Astra who guide users through the journey as well as an interactive world map which is basically a branching narrative hub where users can choose to explore two distinct tales of moon and mars. It features custom cinematic fonts, responsive tablet friendly layouts for kids, full-screen animated GIF backgrounds with dark atmospheric overlays and proper AI-generation disclosure subscripts for my digital image assets. Instead of a static textbook or a boring report I created an engaging, story driven learning experience. By blending whimsical world building with real space history and actual NASA data I've built a tool that can genuinely inspire children to care about science, astronomy and human curiosity.
​
details: I developed Space Treasures, which is a digital storybook and educational web application designed to teach children about historical space exploration and real hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars. The application features two different tales including the Moon and the Mars both of which are navigated by a space crew consisting of four characters. The Moon journey highlights Apollo era legacy artifacts like the ALSEP laboratory, communication antennas and the SNAP-27 generator, while the Mars journey features NASA's twin rovers, Spirit and Opportunity, detailing their 2004 landing, and direct access to NASA mission resources. Building a fully functional, multi-screen, interactive web application entirely from scratch is a fantastic accomplishment for me which frankly I didn't think I could achieve. Built entirely on using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, the project incorporates Google Fonts Cinzel and Fredoka One, the image hosting tool used was imgbb and the whole thing was deployed through Netlify. The project combines both vibe coding as well as manual development. SI has extensively been used for the generation of visuals. This application is creative and impactful because it transforms dry historical data into an immersive, story driven learning experience with edge animated background GIFs, SI generation asset disclosures, and a story line reinforcing that curiosity travels farther than our imagination.
